name: Rimwarden Ysk
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). The ZONE EVENT BOSS for the Caldera: Ysk, a vast glasswing the rim keepers raised to guard the crater, gone wild since they left. P1 'The Watch': talons (cone), a gale of glass down three lines, and the Rim Shriek — a blast round the whole rim; hide behind a rim stone. P2 at 55% 'The Flock': she hangs in the air behind a ward of wingbeats while her flock dives — KILL THE GLASSWINGS to drop it — and glass rains that leaves shards. P3, a new health bar 'Grounded': a wingbeat that throws, a stand-together stack, and eight lines of shards spiralling out. Soft enrage from 4 minutes, hard at 7. OWNER #51 (2026-10-15): the phase that refilled the health bar is removed; the health bar is the whole fight.
party: Zone event, everyone nearby joins. Solo: not intended (the flock and a stack of 3). 3-5: playable. 10+: intended. M5 scaling: health and flock by players enrolled; stack need = clamp(players/4, 2, 5).

pull: A shadow crosses the rim. Wings of black glass, wider than a house.
Rimwarden Ysk lands on the crater edge and the rocks crack under her.
A shriek rings off every glass shard on the rim.
say.death: Rimwarden Ysk falls into the crater, wings folding, and the rim is quiet.
say.reset: Rimwarden Ysk lifts off and circles the crater again.

enrage.say: Ysk screams and the whole rim shakes!

soft.say: The flock gathers overhead. Ysk grows bolder.

glass_gale.name: Glass Gale
glass_gale.say: Ysk beats her wings — a gale of glass in three lines!

shriek.name: Rim Shriek
shriek.say: Ysk draws breath to SHRIEK — get behind a rim stone!

glass_rain.name: Glass Rain
glass_rain.say: Glass falls from her wings — and stays where it lands!

phases.name: The Flock
phases.say: Ysk climbs into the sky and calls her flock!
phases.shieldDown: The last of the flock falls — Ysk drops out of the sky, screaming!

onEnter.say: Ysk hangs behind a ward of beating wings. Kill her three flock birds to drop it! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.

ward.say: Ysk hangs behind a ward of beating wings. Kill her three flock birds to drop it! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.
ward.fade: The ward fails by itself. No opening this time.

do.say: Every rim stone is broken. Nothing left to hide behind!
